steps.text: Talk to Veliaf Hurtz.
Enter the trapdoor behind the Canifis Pub.
Enter the cave on the east side.
Leave the cave.
Leave through the doors to the south.
Cross the bridge to the south.
Board the boat to the south to Mort'ton.
Place some food in the nearby chest.
Talk to Razvan in Burgh de Rott.
choices: Are there any 'out of the way' places here?

steps.text: Use a pickaxe on the rubble in the building south of Razvan.
Enter the trapdoor.
Mine all the rubble in the room, and then clean it up with a spade. You'll need an empty bucket when using the spade. You can empty the buckets outside on the rubble pile.
Leave the basement.
Talk to Aurel in north east Burgh de Rott.
choices: I'd like to help fix up the town.

steps.text: Go to the roof of Aurel's shop.
Repair the broken roof.
Climb back down the ladder.
Repair the shop's wall.
Talk to Aurel again.
Return to Aurel with the filled crate.
Repair the bank booth.
Repair the bank's outside wall.
Talk to Cornelius and ask him to be the banker.
Talk to Razvan.
Repair the furnace in the south east of Burgh de Rott. You can use the bank you just made to get items out.
Add coal to the furnace.
Light the furnace.
Talk to Gadderanks in the shop.
Talk to a juvinate in the shop.
Talk to Wiskit in the shop. Be prepared to fight the vampyres and Gadderanks.

items.name: Silver weapon (including Silverlight + varieties), blessed axe or Efaritay's Aid to damage vampyres

steps.text: Defeat Gadderanks and the juvinates.

steps.text: Talk to Gadderanks.
Talk to Veliaf in Burgh de Rott.
Talk to Veliaf Hurtz.
Kill the juvenates.

steps.text: Talk to Drezel under the Paterdomus Temple.
Talk to Drezel under the Paterdomus Temple.
choices: Is there somewhere that I might get more information on Ivandis?
The lives of those pitiful few left in Morytania could rest on this!

steps.text: Use the key on the keyhole near Drezel.
Enter the library.
Search the bookcases for 'The Sleeping Seven' book.
Read 'The Sleeping Seven'.
Use a hammer on the boarded up cave.
Enter the cave.
Use a piece of soft clay on the coffin.
Make a silvthrill rod at any furnace.
Cast Lvl-1 enchant on the rod.
Enter the Myreque Hideout under the Canifis Pub and talk to Veliaf to start.
Travel to Burgh de Rott, south of Mort'ton, and talk to Florin at the entrance.
Return the Myreque Hideout under the Canifis Pub and talk to Veliaf there. Bank any followers before going.
Talk to Polmafi in the Myreque Hideout.

Talk to Ivan in the Myreque Hideout to temple trek with him. The long route has 4 level 50 Juvinates and the short route has 2 level 75 Juvinates. You can give him a steel med helm / chainbody / platelegs, and salmon to help him survive.
Enter the trapdoor behind the Canifis pub.
Go use the Silvthrill rod on the well in Paterdomus.
Bring the rod to Veliaf in the Burgh de Rott pub's basement to finish the quest.
Fill the crate with 3 tinderboxes, 10 bronze axes, and either 10 raw snails or 10 raw mackerel.

items.name: Raw mackerel or raw snail meat (random for each player)
